name: TrendingSearches
description: Ranked search terms with the results behind each one — a rail of keyword cards on desktop, a ranked accordion on mobile.

figma.notes: PC: English-Site-Optimization-2026 866-44808 (search-keywords-pc), 1824px content box, 444px cards on a 16px gap at 1920. Cards follow BrandProductRail's per-view ladder (2 at 1024, 3 from 1025, 4 from 1440), which reproduces that 444px at the frame width. Mobile: YAMI-UI-UX-Guidelines 6993-64807 (search-keywords-mobile), 386px accordion, one row open.

title.description: Section title. `mobileTitle` swaps in a shorter one below 1024px.

keywords.description: Ranked terms. Each carries its search `href`, an optional `tagline`, a mobile-only `thumbnail`, and the `products` the term returns — three or more, since desktop previews two and mobile scrolls the rest.

seeAllLabel.description: Desktop per-card link copy. The term is appended out of sight so the links are not identical.

expandLabel.description: Accessible name for a mobile row toggle, given the term.

defaultExpandedId.description: Which row opens first on mobile. Defaults to the top-ranked term.

dividerPosition.description: Optional desktop-only full-width section divider edge.

dividerVariant.description: Divider color and width treatment: gray is 1px and black is 2px emphasis.

onAddToCart.description: Quick-add handler forwarded to every product card.

previousLabel.description: Accessible name for the desktop rail's back button.

nextLabel.description: Accessible name for the desktop rail's forward button.

focus.note: Row toggles, per-card links and the mobile CTA each carry a token-backed focus ring.

radius.note: Keyword cards use --radius-surface-default; the tagline and the CTA use --radius-component-default; row thumbnail tiles use --radius-sm. Product cards bring their own — nothing here restyles them.

tapTarget.note: Mobile rows are 40px artwork plus 12px block padding. The mobile CTA has a 32px sm visual height with a transparent 44px pointer target. The desktop see-all link is caption type at 41x20, so a transparent ::before overlay carries its 44px pointer target without growing the visual.

accessibility.role: labelled region containing a ranked list
accessibility.ariaPattern: section[aria-label] wrapping a list; below 1024px each row is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls onto its panel
accessibility.structure: The mobile toggles and the desktop links are each display:none at the other breakpoint, so only one of the two structures reaches the accessibility tree. Rank numbers are aria-hidden — the list order already carries them.
accessibility.interaction: One term is open at a time on mobile; opening another closes it. Desktop shows every card open and pages the rail one card per press.
